examples.text: The little girl jumped from behind the door to welcome her father.
examples.translation: 小女孩从门后跳出来，迎接她的父亲。
examples.speechText: The little girl jumped from behind the door to welcome her father.

examples.text: Today we have cloned mice（mouse的复数形式） and cattle.
examples.translation: 如今，我们已经克隆出了小鼠和牛。
examples.speechText: Today we have cloned mice and cattle.

examples.text: Requiring some time and research to find the perfect project, volunteering is one of the nicest things you can do.
examples.translation: 虽然需要花些时间做调查，找到最适合的志愿项目，但做志愿服务是你能做的最美好的事情之一。
examples.speechText: Requiring some time and research to find the perfect project, volunteering is one of the nicest things you can do.

examples.text: By eleven o'clock yesterday I had arrived at the airport.
examples.translation: 昨天十一点之前，我就已经到达机场了。
examples.speechText: By eleven o'clock yesterday I had arrived at the airport.

examples.text: These factors give coastal deserts unique features（feature的复数形式） that are not found in other deserts.
examples.translation: 这些因素赋予沿海沙漠一些其他沙漠所没有的独特特征。
examples.speechText: These factors give coastal deserts unique features that are not found in other deserts.

examples.text: A person with a flat, dull voice which neither rises nor falls sounds like a flat and dull person!
examples.translation: 一个人如果说话声音平淡、沉闷，没有高低起伏，听起来就像是一个平淡无趣的人！
examples.speechText: A person with a flat, dull voice which neither rises nor falls sounds like a flat and dull person!

examples.text: It does not work as well when your kids get older if their peers (同龄人) do not have landlines, which is why Lundberg has convinced（convince的过去分词形式） some mom friends to join what she calls her "revolution".
examples.translation: 孩子长大后，如果同龄人没有固定电话，这种方式就不会那么奏效；这也是Lundberg说服几位同为母亲的朋友，加入她所说的“革命”的原因。
examples.speechText: It does not work as well when your kids get older if their peers do not have landlines, which is why Lundberg has convinced some mom friends to join what she calls her "revolution".

examples.text: She said that the doctor must have got stuck in a traffic jam; otherwise he would have arrived by then.
examples.translation: 她说，医生一定是堵在路上了，否则那时就已经到了。
examples.speechText: She said that the doctor must have got stuck in a traffic jam; otherwise he would have arrived by then.

examples.text: When you are with a friend who has suffered（suffer的过去分词形式） a tragedy, remember that you are there to provide support and comfort.
examples.translation: 当你陪伴一个遭遇不幸的朋友时，要记住，你是来给予支持和安慰的。
examples.speechText: When you are with a friend who has suffered a tragedy, remember that you are there to provide support and comfort.

examples.text: For example, lots of ads pop up when you click on a link.
examples.translation: 例如，当你点击一个链接时，会弹出许多广告。
examples.speechText: For example, lots of ads pop up when you click on a link.

examples.text: For most people, this includes a steady marriage, but other relationships with family, friends and partners matter as well.
examples.translation: 对大多数人来说，这包括一段稳定的婚姻，但与家人、朋友和伴侣的其他关系也同样重要。
examples.speechText: For most people, this includes a steady marriage, but other relationships with family, friends and partners matter as well.

examples.text: Nervous critics, including many scientists, worry that there is corporate, national, international, and inter-scientific rivalry in the entire biotechnological field.
examples.translation: 包括许多科学家在内的一些批评者忧心忡忡，担心整个生物技术领域存在企业间、国内、国际以及科学家之间的竞争。
examples.speechText: Nervous critics, including many scientists, worry that there is corporate, national, international, and inter-scientific rivalry in the entire biotechnological field.

examples.text: It can also prevent dry and heated indoor air from leading to dry skin and brain fog.
examples.translation: 它还可以防止干燥、开着暖气的室内空气引起皮肤干燥和头脑昏沉。
examples.speechText: It can also prevent dry and heated indoor air from leading to dry skin and brain fog.

examples.text: Whenever possible, do routine work in the afternoon and save tasks requiring more energy or concentration for your sharper hours.
examples.translation: 只要条件允许，就在下午处理常规工作，把需要更多精力或注意力的任务留到头脑更敏锐的时段去做。
examples.speechText: Whenever possible, do routine work in the afternoon and save tasks requiring more energy or concentration for your sharper hours.

examples.text: You can’t change your energy cycle, but you can learn to make your life fit it better.
examples.translation: 你无法改变自己的精力周期，但可以学会让生活更好地适应它。
examples.speechText: You can’t change your energy cycle, but you can learn to make your life fit it better.
